title: Worktree path authority
current: Candidate path recording validates client syntax independently of the server OS: POSIX absolute, Windows drive-rooted and complete backslash UNC paths round-trip without rewriting. Leading forward slashes keep POSIX meaning, including double-slash forms that resemble Windows namespaces. Backslash device namespaces, incomplete UNC and drive-relative or drive-unspecified paths refuse. Existing-checkout recovery uses the current active lane id and branch under the item work claim and preserves physical contents. This metadata change does not promise native Windows runtime support.
